name: Heading
summary: A section title with a semantic level independent of its visual size. Not for emphasis inside a paragraph, or for labelling a control (use the control's label).
a11y: Renders `h1`-`h6` from `level`; the outline follows the page structure, never the visual size.

props.name: children
props.description: The heading text: names the content below it, in sentence case.

props.name: level
props.description: Semantic level from the page outline. Never skip a level for looks.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size, independent of level. Defaults to the level's own size (5 and 6 look like 4). `display` (ramp xxxxl) and `jumbo` (the ramp's top step) are for a landing title or a single figure, at most one per view. `label` is the smallest: the dense body text size in a strong weight, for a group's title in a dense panel (a design tool's inspector), where the rows' own text is that size.

props.name: id
props.description: Fragment identifier, so the heading can be linked to.

props.name: tone
props.description: `accent` (IP22): the whole heading in the brand colour, on the accent display role at size 2 and larger (3:1, large text) and the accent text role below. For one phrase, wrap it in `<Text as="span" variant="inherit" tone="accent">` instead. Default: the text colour.

settings.description: The display step's size: Hero and page titles, Heading size="display" and Statistic's large value (default text.xxxxl, 3.5rem). A token (var(--text-…)) or a length.
The display step's weight (default weight.bold). Set 400 for a display face that has one weight, so the browser doesn't fake bold.
The display step's line height (default leading.display). A unitless number or a token.
The display step's letter spacing (default tracking.display). A length in em or a token.
The jumbo step's size: Heading size="jumbo" (default text.jumbo, 5rem). Keep it larger than display; settingsCss and applySettings refuse a jumbo smaller than display when both are lengths.
The jumbo step's line height (default leading.display).
The jumbo step's letter spacing (default tracking.display).
